notes.page_content: The page continues an argument, sets out two partitions and a five-term partition with overlapping braces, defines Sigma12, then writes closure inclusions and two nonempty-intersection assertions followed by a lower argument. This is an account of the written content only.
notes.author_uncertainty: No separate authorial question mark or explicit verbal uncertainty was identified on this page. Editorial unsure qualifications identify unresolved ink.
notes.title_date_page_counts: No title or date is present. The lower-left 15 is retained only as % archive sheet number: 15. H has page{15}; packet metadata identifies our scan 16. No manuscript-page command is supplied.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: All signs and words were selected from the visible strokes. No mathematical computation, proof check, equivalence check or repair was performed. The page's own lower argument is transcribed without reconstruction.
notes.H_apparatus: H's notes describing the two braces and the lower underbrace are editorial descriptions of drawn content. Their wording is not supplied as manuscript prose. The braces and their labels are retained in the TeX.
notes.square_join_typography: The live square-bottomed joins of the two partitions and cancelled lower expression have two uprights and an overhanging baseline; reading.tex uses amalg. H's sqcup tokens for those same witness loci are handled as typographical notation rather than separate lexical corrections. At the final two overwritten joins the deleted/live states and rounded cup shapes receive separate physical-locus records U1 and U2.
notes.graphical_qualification: The added M01/M02/M03 point candidates are locally unsure. Their positions are preserved; their hand, character or role and surface origin remain unresolved. G02 preserves observed rule components without assigning a precise framing or guiding role.
notes.placement: The containing clause and its two inserted phrases are held in a local figure so the guide paths can be retained once. The lower cancelled phrase and raised replacement are likewise one local figure. Every word is present once as visible content; the extra deletion copy is phantom only.
notes.image_delivery: The full scan was opened once, then half a once, then half b once. The 17 planned crop files were each opened once and delivered successfully. No viewed image was reopened; no locus was recropped.
notes.boundary_limits: The top right inserted subscript and guide continuations, ouverts endpoint, final bracket and bottom underbrace label approach physical page edges. The crop files include the available source boundary. The mark-only crops intentionally contain their complete isolated clusters and available surrounding blank paper; no nearby text lies within those tight rectangles.
